Engineers collaborate on advanced algorithms and system designs, delivering impactful business results with immediate operational feedback. jobs.title: AI Engineer V (Principal)
jobs.description:
Overview:

The AI Engineer V (Principal) is the most senior individual-contributor technical authority for artificial intelligence and machine learning within AssistRx Engineering. Reporting to the Vice President, Engineering, this role defines and drives the company’s AI technical strategy and leads the design, build, and deployment of production-grade AI solutions across the specialty medication access ecosystem, including large language model applications, predictive models, intelligent document processing, and agentic automation that improve speed, accuracy, and scale in patient onboarding, benefits verification, prior authorization, document intake, and patient and provider engagement.

The AI Engineer V (Principal) shapes AI direction at the enterprise level, solves the company’s most complex and ambiguous technical problems, and sets the architecture, evaluation standards, and responsible AI practices for all AI work at AssistRx. The role serves as a trusted advisor to engineering and executive leadership, represents AssistRx’s AI capabilities with clients, partners, and auditors, and develops the next generation of AI technical leaders. The Principal AI Engineer partners closely with Software Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data, Security, Compliance, and Client Services, and is accountable for the quality, performance, cost efficiency, and safe and compliant use of AI with protected health information across the enterprise.

jobs.description:

**Location**: Fort Worth, TX or Palmdale, CA.

**Salary Range:** $123,600 - $164,800 + Bonus Eligible

**Company Overview**

Founded in 2004 with locations in Atlanta, GA, Fort Worth, TX, Denver, CO, & Huntsville, AL, Thompson Software Solutions (TSS) is a mission-driven aerospace and defense software and systems engineering company supporting the U.S. military, defense primes, and commercial space partners. We specialize in the development, integration, test, and deployment of safety & mission-critical software systems that power next-generation aircraft, defense platforms, and space technologies. Our team understands what it takes to modernize complex embedded systems while maintaining the rigor, compliance, and reliability required for mission and safety-critical environments.

As a defense-focused company of highly skilled and dedicated engineers, we take pride in solving complex technical challenges that directly impact national security and operational readiness. We partner closely with customers across the military aviation and space domains to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions with portability, sustainability, and long-term mission success in mind.

**Description**

This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to next-generation avionics architectures that enhance interoperability, rapid capability integration, and mission effectiveness for U.S. military aviation programs.
